ourStandardWomenswearRange: Our 'Standard' womenswear range has been designed for a woman whose height is 168 (5ft 6inches) and who has an inside leg of 79cm. The fit of a garment may vary depending on the cut, style, and fabric.
swipeLeftOrRight: Swipe left or right to see all sizes
takeYourActualBodyMeasurements: Take your actual body measurements as they are more accurate than measuring over your clothes.
bustMeasure: Measure under the arms at the fullest part around the bust horizontally.
hipsMeasure: With the feet together measure around fullest part.
insideLegMeasure: In bare feet, take the measurement from the top of the inside leg and measure down the inside leg to the floor.
heightMeasure: With bare feet together, measure the top of the head to the floor.
skirtLengthMeasure: Measure from natural waist line to the knee.
findingThePerfectFit: Whether you're looking for pretty pyjamas or something slinky, you can be confident in finding the perfect fit in our nightwear range. The fit of an item may vary depending on cut, style and fabric.
collarMeasure: Measure around the base of the neck where the collar sits.
chestMeasure: Measure the chest at the fullest part, placing the tape close up under the arms.
legInsideMeasure: Measure from the crotch to where your trouser is normally worn on the shoe.
jacketMeasure: Measure from the centre back of your neck to your hemline. Then length measurement will vary depending on the style of garment.
bodyMeasurementsThatWeUse: Below you will find the body measurements that we use. Most of our product is available in single sizes, this means the sizes increase at an interval of 1 year i.e 7-8, 8-9, 9-10, 10-11 and so on. If you are buying jumpers and cardigans please use the dual size table. This means the sizes increase at intervals of 2 years in the older sizes. i.e 9-10, 11-12, 13-14. If you are buying trousers or blazers, the size guide states length of the product, not the body measurement.
neckMeasure: Measure around the base of the neck where the collar touches the skin.
kidsMeasure: These measurements are body size not garment size. Please Measure your child to determine which age group they sit with and then buy the clothes size accordingly.
hatMeasure: Our kids' hats are sized by age, but we recommend measuring the circumference of your child's head to find the perfect size.
kidsShoeGuide: Our kids’ shoes come in UK sizes 4 small to 7.5 large, so we’ll see them through from their first pair to their grown-up shoes with our handy measuring guide and size chart. Our kids’ socks are sized slightly differently – use the table below to find the perfect fit for your little one.
